title: Ford's Theatre
visualBrief: Red-brick theatre with five-bay white stone arcade, two tiers of tall arched windows, raised central pediment and slate gable.

appearance.colorEncoding: sRGB palette decoded to linear COLOR_0

geographicProposal.groundContactBasis: Reviewed front terrain reference at model Y0 and foundation down to -1.25 m; preserved Terrarium footprint samples span -0.773 to 0.376 m relative to this reference. Current source-terrain captures show visible steps and no floating foundations.

terrainReference.basis: Front ground reference in the signed local map frame; separately preserved terrain-grid.json.

geographicProposal.notes: The mapped envelope includes a 23.23 m theatre rectangle and approximately 10 m lower south frontage with shorter depth. Partition at the mapped rear step is generalized, not a surveyed party wall. The source model retains both masses and rear step. The public-domain 1865 Qualla photograph confirms three ridge ventilators;the public-domain NPS 2007 exterior confirms current facade forms. Hidden rear service openings are approximate, not independently measured. Earlier HABS imagery is excluded from current visual approval.

limitations: Current five-bay theatre and lower south Star Saloon wing, original medium-fi exterior geometry. No interiors, neighboring taller buildings or borrowed meshes.

Generalized Protomaps ensemble partition and facade proportions are estimates. The public-domain 1865 Qualla photograph confirms the facade and three ridge ventilators; the explicitly public-domain NPS 2007 exterior confirms surviving front details. Hidden rear service forms remain approximate.

Terrarium host samples supply ground evidence, not a survey. The foundation extends 1.25 m below the street reference; terrain-contact placement samples the declared front reference point. Dataset resolution and vertical accuracy remain host-dependent.

Fine carved window ornament, hardware, rear openings and roof dimensions are simplified estimates. Earlier attribution-licensed photographs and rights-unverified HABS illustrations are excluded from current imagery approval. Reference photographs stay in local caches and are not embedded or redistributed.
